caption: The drawing depicts a dagger with an ornate design, lying horizontally on a plain, light beige background. The dagger is colored in shades of gold, brown, and green. The handle consists of two outward-curving arms with circular ends, each decorated with geometric patterns in green and gold. The guard area features a diamond-shaped section containing intricate linear designs. The blade portion is sheathed or covered, and the sheath is adorned with an elaborate pattern that includes a combination of swirling motifs and interlocking geometric shapes in green and gold hues. The overall outline of the dagger is distinct, with clear demarcation between the handle, guard, and blade/sheath. The artist’s signature, “Marius N. Hansen,” appears in red cursive script in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Bootjack
